procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the nine pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (the ROTATE_90 render is upside down -- banner 'Official Recapitulation GENERAL'; cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/jones/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11 over table A, 4/4 over table B, with the X-cells filling 0 under their rows' own printed TOTALs).
structure_note: Nine-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3+p4+p5 = table A over the county's THIRTY-EIGHT precincts (11 columns ANTIOCH..GLADE, then 11 columns HEBRON..OAK PARK ALUMNI BLDG, then 11 columns OVETT..SHARON, then SHELTON/SOSO/SPRINGHILL/MAULDIN/TUCKERS/UNION + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 3, House 4, CoA 4 Position 2, and Chancery 19 Place 1; p6+p7+p8+p9 = table B over the same column split carrying Chancery 19 Place 2, Circuit 18 Places 1-2, and two local sections (county court judge + two school boards). Jones STRADDLES congressional districts: House 3's rows X-cell thirty-four of the print and carry values only at MATTHEWS, SANDERSVILLE, SHADY GROVE and SHARON, while House 4's rows (printed REP-first) X-cell exactly those four and carry the other thirty-four -- the mirrors referee both sides to their printed TOTALs. CoA 4 Position 2 (David McCarty) X-cells twelve precincts (ANTIOCH, ERATA, GLADE, LANDRUM, MYRICK, POWERS, RUSTIN, SANDERSVILLE, SHADY GROVE, SHARON, SPRINGHILL/MAULDIN, TUCKERS). The precinct headers print UPPERCASE on this county's SEMS sheet. Races: U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins); US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (Chiaradio/Guest/Klehle -- the House 3 roster, names identical -- but Jones prints 'Erik Klehle' like the other seventeen D3 counties, NOT Winston's one-letter variant); US House Of Rep 04-4th Congressional District (Mike Ezell REP first, then Jeffrey Hulum III DEM, then Carl Boyanton IND -- the House 4 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- the CoA 4 roster alone, names identical, THIRTEENTH county); Chancery Court 19-Chancery District 19 Place 1 (Jerry D. Sharp) and Place 2 (Kathryn Dickerson Clay) -- the full Chancery 19 roster, names identical (THIRD county: Greene/Wayne then Jones); Circuit Court 18-Circuit District 18 Place 1 (Brad R. Thompson, Eric Tiebauer) and Place 2 (Darryl A. Hurt Jr.) -- the full Circuit 18 roster, names identical (FOURTH county). Printed totals: Colom 7576, Hyde-Smith 12282, Pinkins 677, Chiaradio 905, Guest 1989, Klehle 44, Ezell 11128, Hulum 6048, Boyanton 413, McCarty 12075, Sharp 18431, Clay 18215, Thompson 15380, Tiebauer 3940, Hurt 18215.
operator_rows_note: All 15 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3+p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL, table-B rows carry p6+p7+p8+p9 cells + the p9 printed TOTAL. X-marked cells fill 0 under each row's own printed TOTAL (all fifteen reconcile with the X fills).
truncation_note: No truncations; the thirty-eight precinct headers print complete in the sheet's own UPPERCASE forms (ANTIOCH, BIG CREEK, BLACKWELL, CALHOUN, CENTERVILLE, CURRIE, ERATA, FIRST ASSEMBLY OF GOD, GEORGE HARRISON, GITANO, GLADE, HEBRON, JOHNSON, LT ELLIS CENTER, LANDRUM, MAGNOLIA CENTER, MATTHEWS, MERCHANTS PARK, MOSELLE, MYRICK, NORTH LAUREL, OAK PARK ALUMNI BLDG, OVETT, PARKVIEW BAPTIST CHURCH, PINE GROVE, PLEASANT RIDGE, POWERS, RAINEY, RUSTIN, SAND HILL, SANDERSVILLE, SHADY GROVE, SHARON, SHELTON, SOSO, SPRINGHILL/MAULDIN, TUCKERS, UNION).
local_note: p6-p9 carry three local sections after Circuit 18 Place 2: 'Jones-County Court Judge' (M. Wayne Thompson -- a county court judge, local), 'School Board 3-District 3' (Randy Norwood) and 'School Board 4-District 4' (Dan Ashley) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows. Chancery 19's printed Places are 1 and 2; Circuit 18's printed Places are 1 and 2; CoA 4's printed Places are Position 2 only (matching the other twelve CoA 4 counties).
